synth.notes:
Board = 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours (wall 10, target 11, piece 5, mirror 4, bg 9); H band row / V strip col = most wall cells.
A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (min col desc, then min row desc) -> H; A1/A2 move H or the selected piece, A3/A4 move V or the piece; pieces are blocked by the board edge and other pieces, axes only by the edge.
Every piece block mirrors across V, across H and across both, drawn as solid-ring colour 4; layer order piece > mirror > target (solid) > V wall > H wall; the selected axis/piece shows 0 centres.
HUD column 63 gains one colour-12 cell per effective action. Passes 44/44 with the hidden state removed too; render(parse(f)) == f on every frame.
Unconfirmed: A5 order with more than 2 pieces, whether mirrors hide when a piece touches an axis (never observed), A6/A7 (treated as no-ops).
